tabs.label: Parts of the supplier
tabs.acknowledgementsTitle: POs sent to the supplier and their acknowledgement

docSummary.allOk: Every required document is in and still valid
docSummary.notOk: A required document is missing, or one has expired
docSummary.none: No document type is required for this kind of supplier, and the supplier has sent none yet

contacts.intro: A contact is a person of the supplier who signs in to the portal with their own e-mail and receives the supplier's notices
contacts.addressHidden: Contacts' e-mails and phone numbers are shown to procurement only
contacts.emptyTitle: This supplier has no contact yet
contacts.emptyHint: Contacts come from an approved application or are added by procurement; they will be listed here
contacts.emptyHintManage: Press "Add a contact" so a person of the supplier can sign in to the portal and receive the supplier's notices
contacts.liveSessions: Signed in on {count, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}}
contacts.addTitle: Add a contact of the supplier
contacts.addDescription: The supplier's e-mail in the register and the primary contact before are told who was added; nothing is sent to the new address

fields.emailHint: The contact signs in to the portal with this e-mail. One e-mail belongs to one contact in the organization
fields.isPrimaryHint: The supplier's notices go to the primary contact; the primary contact before stops being one
fields.locale: Language of the e-mails and portal pages

contacts.emailInvalid: Enter a valid e-mail, for example name@company.co.th
contacts.revokeTitle: Sign {name} out of the portal on every device?
contacts.revokeBody: Every device signed in is signed out at once. The contact can still sign in again with their e-mail; to stop that, switch their portal access off or close the contact
contacts.deactivateBody: The contact is signed out of every device at once, can no longer sign in to the portal and no longer receives the supplier's notices. This cannot be undone: to let them in again, add them as a new contact
contacts.deactivatePrimary: This is the primary contact. Make someone else the primary contact first, so the supplier's notices still reach someone

done.deactivated: The contact was closed and signed out of every device
done.revoked: The contact was signed out of every device
done.portalOff: {name}'s portal access was switched off and they were signed out of every device

errors.FORBIDDEN: You may not manage the supplier's contacts; only procurement can
errors.MODULE_DISABLED: The organization has not switched the supplier module on
errors.NOT_FOUND: This contact was not found or is already closed. Reload the page and try again
errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: Someone changed this contact after you opened the page. Reload the page and try again
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An active contact already has this e-mail. Use another one
errors.NO_SESSION: This contact is not signed in on any device
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Something is not right. Check the name and the e-mail
errors.FAILED: That did not work. Try again

acks.intro: When a contact of the supplier acknowledges a PO on the portal, you see when, who, and the delivery date the supplier promised
acks.emptyTitle: No PO has been sent to this supplier yet
acks.emptyHint: When an approved PO is sent to the supplier it is listed here, and once the supplier acknowledges it on the portal you see when and the delivery date promised
acks.more: Showing the latest {limit} of {total}. The others are on the purchase orders page

portal.on: This supplier may use the portal
portal.off: This supplier does not use the portal yet
portal.onHint: Contacts with portal access sign in to acknowledge POs and to see and send documents
portal.offHint: The portal opens for a supplier when its application is approved. To bring an existing supplier onto the portal, invite it from the invite page
portal.readOnly: The portal of the whole supplier cannot be switched on or off from this page yet. To keep someone out, switch off each contact's portal access below
portal.inactive: This supplier is no longer used, so its contacts cannot sign in to the portal
portal.urlHint: Send this address to the contacts. They sign in with their own e-mail and a code the system e-mails them
portal.contactsTitle: Contacts who may use the portal
portal.contactsHint: Switching access off signs the contact out of every device at once; it can be switched on again later
portal.noContacts: There is no active contact yet. Add one on the Contacts tab
